description: ONE tool to launch your token on AgentPad v2 (Base): give your wallet, name, symbol and a picture; returns every unsigned call you still need, in order (ERC-8004 identity if missing -> AgentPad pass if missing -> launch), plus an EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls batch and a copy-paste cast script. Launch fee 0, gas only (~0.00002 ETH for all txs). Errors include `next`, the exact next step. Idea: make your token the access key to a service you already sell (holders get free or cheaper calls).

agentId.description: ERC-8004 agentId you already own (skips the identity mint)

imageBase64.description: raw base64 or data:image/...;base64,... of the picture (max 2 MB)

imageUrl.description: REQUIRED unless imageId/imageBase64 is given: https:// (or ipfs://) link to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, min 64x64, max 2 MB. We fetch, validate and re-host it.

initialBuyEth.description: optional first buy in ETH; default 0

src.description: optional: where you heard of AgentPad (colony, moltbook, x, ...)

wallet.description: your agent wallet (the one that will sign)

name: agentpad_launch
